remarks: OMG! a 3-Bedroom home in the highly coveted Rowayton Woods Association w/ lake views for under $800k! Enter rising 6-steps to easy one-level, ranch-style living, this end-unit receives natural light on 3-sides, offers an large, open floor plan and a freshly painted interior w/ many recent updates including kitchen, bathrooms, lighting, carpeting & flooring and more. Large, bright Living Room/ Dining area boasts a fireplace, built-ins, plantation shutters and sliding door to your private, covered 90 sqft deck with gorgeous lake views. Beautifully updated Kitchen features bright white cabinets & quartz countertops including large breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances incl gas cooktop plus huge, double pantry cabinet. Primary Bedroom Suite is an oasis w/ lake-facing views, walk-in closet w/ built-ins & spa-like Primary Bathroom. Two additional Bedrooms share the second Full Bathroom. In-unit Laundry Room plus generous closet space throughout incl a 6 x 3 shelved, walk-in storage closet. Rowayton Woods tranquil setting features an in-ground pool, tennis court, walking trails, private lake & community garden yet is just 1-mile from Rowayton Village & 2-miles to The Sono Collection, South Norwalk, I-95, and Downtown Darien. Dedicated storage unit located in adjoining building. Your reserved space (#196) is located directly in front of the unit. Come visit today
